scope: Read all 32 authored resources, checked worked examples and internal consistency, and compared cited sources with their limited stated purpose. Recorded final generated download hashes.
limitations: No independent practitioner review or professional credentials.
No project-specific engineering, legal, regulatory, purchasing or installation approval.
Hash recording does not by itself prove compatibility in every native editor; consult the separate artifact QA evidence.
No invented clients, testimonials, owners, permissions or business outcomes.
